script_text: GEMINI — Mercury, your ruling planet in Air, is about to rewrite your entire week. Early Monday through Wednesday, Mercury retrograde forms a harsh square to Neptune in your 7th House of partnerships, so old flames or messy relationship dynamics resurface — stay sharp as foggy truths surface by Tuesday. Thursday marks the turning point: Venus trines your Midheaven, and your 10th House of career explodes with momentum — a promotion, a signed deal, or public recognition lands right in your lap. By Friday through Sunday, Jupiter enters your 2nd House sextile Mercury, making Saturday your power day because money literally finds you through a side hustle or unexpected bonus. Your worst day is Tuesday, when Mercury square Neptune clouds your judgment in love. My advice: hold your cards close until Thursday. Follow for daily updates.
